## Manager 90 priorities
1. React best practices for implementation quality.
2. Web design guidelines for UI review.
3. Composition patterns for reusable component architecture.
4. React view transitions when motion/navigation benefits from them.
5. Vercel optimization and deployment guidance when working on delivery/performance.
